AUTO-GENERATED by packages/exponential-ui/scripts/generate.ts — do not edit.
Source of truth: packages/exponential-ui/catalog/core.catalog.json (+ tokens.json, style.json, basic-map.json). One entry per component: what ui.exponential.at renders as the component's page (VAPP-93). specimenId = the id of its specimen there, painted once each renderer lands.

components.name: Box
components.description: A styled container laid out by the whitelisted style object; the primitive every macro expands into.

props.name: style
props.description: Layout and visual properties from the Box whitelist (flex, grid, sizes, spacing, colours).

props.name: pressable
props.description: Makes the box a press target that fires `press`.

components.name: Stack
components.description: A flex container that lays its children out in one direction with a gap.

props.name: gap
props.type: none | xs | sm | md | lg | xl

props.name: justify
props.type: start | center | end | between | around | evenly

props.name: wrap
props.description: Lets children wrap onto new lines.

props.name: style
props.description: Extra Box styles merged over the stack's own.

components.macro: Expands to natives (see catalog/macros.json); the theme styles its parts by recipe Stack/<part>.

components.name: Grid
components.description: An equal-column grid for cards and tiles.

props.name: gap
props.type: none | xs | sm | md | lg | xl

props.name: style
props.description: Extra Box styles merged over the grid's own.

components.macro: Expands to natives (see catalog/macros.json); the theme styles its parts by recipe Grid/<part>.

components.name: Card
components.description: A bordered content card with an optional title and description; use it for grouped content, not page headers.

props.name: description
props.description: A muted line under the heading.

props.name: padded
props.description: Pads the body; off for edge-to-edge rows.

props.name: style
props.description: Extra Box styles merged over the card's own.

components.macro: Expands to natives (see catalog/macros.json); the theme styles its parts by recipe Card/<part>.

components.name: Separator
components.description: A hairline that divides content.

props.name: orientation
props.description: A horizontal rule or a vertical bar.

components.macro: Expands to natives (see catalog/macros.json); the theme styles its parts by recipe Separator/<part>.

components.name: List
components.description: A windowed scrolling list; required for anything longer than a screen, children may come from a data template.

props.name: gap
props.type: none | xs | sm | md | lg | xl

props.name: style
props.description: Extra Box styles for the list frame.

components.name: Band
components.description: A filled header strip over a run of flat rows, with a title and an optional count.

props.name: count
props.description: A count shown after the title.

props.name: variant
props.description: `group` is the issue-list status group header with its glyph slot.

components.macro: Expands to natives (see catalog/macros.json); the theme styles its parts by recipe Band/<part>.

components.name: RowList
components.description: The flat list language: hairline-divided rows under a band, optionally with tree guides.

props.name: guides
props.description: Reserves the gutter for nested rows' tree connectors.

props.name: style
props.description: Extra Box styles for the list frame.

components.macro: Expands to natives (see catalog/macros.json); the theme styles its parts by recipe RowList/<part>.

components.name: Group
components.description: A form-field container: a rounded group of rows with an optional title and footnote.

props.name: footer
props.description: A muted note under the group.

components.macro: Expands to natives (see catalog/macros.json); the theme styles its parts by recipe Group/<part>.

components.name: Text
components.description: A run of text in one of the type styles; prefer dedicated components over inline markdown.

props.name: variant
props.type: body | caption | muted | lead | code | label | title

props.name: lines
props.description: Truncates to this many lines with an ellipsis.

props.name: tone
props.type: neutral | primary | success | warning | danger | info
props.description: A colour tone instead of the default foreground.

props.name: style
props.description: Extra Box styles for the text box.

components.name: Heading
components.description: A section or page heading at one of four levels.

props.name: level
props.description: h1 is the page title, h4 the smallest.

components.macro: Expands to natives (see catalog/macros.json); the theme styles its parts by recipe Heading/<part>.

components.name: Markdown
components.description: Rendered GitHub-flavoured markdown (paragraphs, lists, code, tables, images), the one interchange every platform shares.

components.name: Image
components.description: A picture from a URL, or a placeholder box when it has none.

props.name: src
props.description: The image URL; omit for a placeholder.

props.name: fit
props.description: How the picture fills its box.

props.name: width
props.description: Fixed width in px; otherwise the box decides.

props.name: aspectRatio
props.description: Width over height when only one side is known.

props.name: style
props.description: Extra Box styles for the image box.

components.name: Icon
components.description: One icon from the shared Lucide registry, by name.

props.name: name
props.description: The icon name (an icons.json concept or Lucide name).

props.name: tone
props.type: neutral | primary | success | warning | danger | info
props.description: A colour tone instead of the current text colour.

props.name: label
props.description: An accessibility label when the icon stands alone.

components.name: Video
components.description: An inline video player with native controls.

props.name: src
props.description: The video URL (H.264 + AAC MP4 plays everywhere).

props.name: durationMs
props.description: Known length, for the scrubber before metadata loads.

props.name: style
props.description: Extra Box styles for the player box.

components.name: AudioPlayer
components.description: An inline audio player with a title and native controls.

props.name: durationMs
props.description: Known length, for the scrubber before metadata loads.

components.name: Avatar
components.description: A round user picture that falls back to initials on a stable hue.

props.name: name
props.description: The person's name; initials come from it.

props.name: seed
props.description: A stable id the fallback hue is hashed from; defaults to the name.

components.name: Carousel
components.description: A horizontally paging scroller; each child is one page.

props.name: loop
props.description: Wraps from the last page to the first.

components.name: Tabs
components.description: Tab navigation; the child at index i is the panel of tab i.

props.name: value
props.description: The active tab's value; bind it for two-way state.

props.name: fill
props.description: Stretches the headers across the width.

components.name: ToggleGroup
components.description: A row of toggle buttons selecting one or many values; `segmented` is the pill-shaped segmented control.

props.name: value
props.description: The selected value (comma-joined when multiple); bind it.

props.name: variant
props.description: Button look, outlined, or the segmented control.

props.name: fill
props.description: Stretches the items across the width.

components.name: Accordion
components.description: Collapsible sections; the child at index i is the body of item i.

props.name: type
props.description: One section open at a time, or any number.

props.name: value
props.description: The open section's value (comma-joined when multiple); bind it.

components.name: Collapsible
components.description: One disclosure section with a title row that shows or hides its children.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the body shows; bind it.

props.name: count
props.description: A count shown in the header.

components.macro: Expands to natives (see catalog/macros.json); the theme styles its parts by recipe Collapsible/<part>.

components.name: Pagination
components.description: Previous, next and the current page out of a total.
components.macro: Expands to natives (see catalog/macros.json); the theme styles its parts by recipe Pagination/<part>.

components.name: ButtonGroup
components.description: Attached buttons with one selected value.

props.name: selected
props.description: The selected button's value; bind it.

components.macro: Expands to natives (see catalog/macros.json); the theme styles its parts by recipe ButtonGroup/<part>.

components.name: Dialog
components.description: A centred modal over the surface, opened by its trigger slot or by binding `open`.

props.name: description
props.description: A muted line under the heading.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether it shows; bind it to a boolean path.

props.name: dismissible
props.description: Closes on the backdrop or Escape.

components.name: Drawer
components.description: A panel sliding in from an edge (a bottom sheet on phones).

props.name: description
props.description: A muted line under the heading.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether it shows; bind it to a boolean path.

components.name: Sheet
components.description: A side sheet: a drawer from the trailing edge.

props.name: description
props.description: A muted line under the heading.

components.macro: Expands to natives (see catalog/macros.json); the theme styles its parts by recipe Sheet/<part>.

components.name: Popover
components.description: A small panel anchored to its trigger, opened on press.

components.name: Tooltip
components.description: A short hint shown on hover or long-press over its children.

components.name: DropdownMenu
components.description: A menu of actions behind a trigger; the default trigger is a button with the label.

props.name: label
props.description: The default trigger's text when no trigger slot is given.

components.name: Badge
components.description: A small status label or count.

props.name: variant
props.type: default | secondary | outline | ghost | destructive | link

components.macro: Expands to natives (see catalog/macros.json); the theme styles its parts by recipe Badge/<part>.

components.name: Alert
components.description: An inline banner with an icon, a title and a message.

props.name: type
props.description: The severity, which picks the icon and tone.

components.macro: Expands to natives (see catalog/macros.json); the theme styles its parts by recipe Alert/<part>.

components.name: Pill
components.description: A rounded chip for a filter, a label or a state; optionally selected, with a colour dot or an icon.

props.name: selected
props.description: Draws it as the active choice.

props.name: tone
props.type: neutral | primary | success | warning | danger | info

props.name: dot
props.description: A colour dot before the text (a label chip).

props.name: pressable
props.description: Makes it a press target that fires `press`.

components.macro: Expands to natives (see catalog/macros.json); the theme styles its parts by recipe Pill/<part>.

components.name: EmptyState
components.description: A centred icon, title and explanation for an empty list, with an optional action.

props.name: description
props.description: Why, or what to do next.

props.name: actionLabel
props.description: A button label; pressing it fires `press`.

components.macro: Expands to natives (see catalog/macros.json); the theme styles its parts by recipe EmptyState/<part>.

components.name: Progress
components.description: A horizontal progress bar with an optional label.

props.name: tone
props.type: neutral | primary | success | warning | danger | info

components.macro: Expands to natives (see catalog/macros.json); the theme styles its parts by recipe Progress/<part>.

components.name: Meter
components.description: A usage track: a bar of coloured segments against a maximum, with a caption and a value.

props.name: value
props.description: A formatted value after the track.

components.macro: Expands to natives (see catalog/macros.json); the theme styles its parts by recipe Meter/<part>.

components.name: Ring
components.description: A circular progress ring for a fraction, sized like an icon.

props.name: tone
props.type: neutral | primary | success | warning | danger | info

components.name: Spinner
components.description: An indeterminate activity indicator.

components.name: Skeleton
components.description: A shimmering placeholder block while content loads.

props.name: width
props.description: A length (px or %); defaults to the full width.

props.name: height
props.description: A length (px); defaults to one text line.

props.name: rounded
props.description: A circle instead of a bar.

components.name: Table
components.description: A small data table from header labels and rows of cell strings; v1 lays it out as a grid without sorting.

props.name: rows
props.description: One array of cell strings per row.

components.macro: Expands to natives (see catalog/macros.json); the theme styles its parts by recipe Table/<part>.

components.name: Chart
components.description: A bar, line, area or pie chart from categories and series (VAPP-50; painters land later).

props.name: categories
props.description: The x-axis labels, or the pie slices.

props.name: series
props.description: One series per line, bar group or pie ring.

components.name: Button
components.description: A press target with a label and optional icon (or one custom child); bind `press` for the handler.

props.name: label
props.description: The button text (omit for an icon-only button).

props.name: icon
props.description: An icon before the label, or alone with size `icon`.

props.name: variant
props.type: default | secondary | outline | ghost | destructive | link
props.description: `default` is the primary action, `destructive` a dangerous one, `ghost` and `link` quiet ones.

props.name: size
props.description: Control height class; `icon` is a square icon-only button.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner and refuses presses.

components.name: Link
components.description: Inline link text that opens a URL or fires `press`.

props.name: href
props.description: The URL to open; omit to handle `press` yourself.

props.name: external
props.description: Marks it as leaving the app.

components.name: Toggle
components.description: A two-state button that stays pressed.

props.name: label
props.description: The button text or accessibility label.

props.name: icon
props.description: An icon before or instead of the label.

components.name: Input
components.description: A single-line text field the host owns; bind `value` for two-way state and add `checks` for validation.

props.name: name
props.description: The field's key in the submitted data.

props.name: type
props.type: text | email | password | number | search | url | tel

props.name: value
props.description: The text; bind it to a data path.

props.name: checks
props.description: Validation rules (required, email, length, regex, numeric).

components.name: Textarea
components.description: A multi-line text field the host owns; bind `value` for two-way state.

props.name: name
props.description: The field's key in the submitted data.

props.name: value
props.description: The text; bind it to a data path.

components.name: Checkbox
components.description: A labelled checkbox; bind `checked`.

props.name: name
props.description: The field's key in the submitted data.

components.name: Radio
components.description: A labelled group of radio options choosing one value; bind `value`.

props.name: name
props.description: The field's key in the submitted data.

components.name: Switch
components.description: A labelled on/off switch; bind `checked`.

props.name: name
props.description: The field's key in the submitted data.

props.name: description
props.description: A muted line under the label.

components.name: Slider
components.description: A range slider between min and max; bind `value`.

components.name: Select
components.description: A picker of one (or many) options in a dropdown; searchable, and `source` binds the host's own lists (statuses, members) instead of inline options.

props.name: name
props.description: The field's key in the submitted data.

props.name: options
props.description: Inline choices; omit when `source` is set.

props.name: source
props.description: A host list id (e.g. `exp:statuses`) that supplies the options.

props.name: value
props.description: The chosen value (comma-joined when multiple); bind it.

props.name: searchable
props.description: Adds a filter field to the list.

components.name: DatePicker
components.description: A calendar date field (date only in v1); bind `value` as an ISO date.

props.name: name
props.description: The field's key in the submitted data.

props.name: value
props.description: The chosen day as yyyy-mm-dd, or empty.

components.name: Composer
components.description: The chat input box: a growing text field with a submit button and optional attachments.

props.name: busy
props.description: Turns submit into a stop while a reply streams.

components.name: ListRow
components.description: A flat list row: an optional leading icon, a title with a subtitle, trailing meta text.

props.name: meta
props.description: Trailing muted text (a count, a time).

props.name: selected
props.description: Draws it as the active row.

components.macro: Expands to natives (see catalog/macros.json); the theme styles its parts by recipe ListRow/<part>.

components.name: CardRow
components.description: A gapped card-shaped row with a title, a subtitle and an optional leading icon.
components.macro: Expands to natives (see catalog/macros.json); the theme styles its parts by recipe CardRow/<part>.

components.name: PropertyRow
components.description: A label on the left and a value on the right, for read-only properties.
components.macro: Expands to natives (see catalog/macros.json); the theme styles its parts by recipe PropertyRow/<part>.

components.name: PickerRow
components.description: A form row that shows a chosen value and opens a picker on press.
components.macro: Expands to natives (see catalog/macros.json); the theme styles its parts by recipe PickerRow/<part>.

components.name: NavRow
components.description: A sidebar or drawer navigation row with an icon, a label, a count and a selected state.

props.name: selected
props.description: Draws it as the current destination.

components.macro: Expands to natives (see catalog/macros.json); the theme styles its parts by recipe NavRow/<part>.

components.name: EntityChip
components.description: A compact chip naming an entity with an icon or picture, optionally removable.

props.name: image
props.description: A leading picture instead of the icon.

props.name: removable
props.description: Shows a remove control that fires `remove`.

components.macro: Expands to natives (see catalog/macros.json); the theme styles its parts by recipe EntityChip/<part>.

components.name: TreeGuides
components.description: The tree connector gutter beside a nested row: an elbow at its depth and pass-through lines for deeper ancestors.

props.name: elbowAt
props.description: The gutter index that draws the elbow into this row; omit for a root.

props.name: tee
props.description: Continues the line past this row to a later sibling.

props.name: passThrough
props.description: Gutter indexes whose ancestor line continues straight through.
